messages:
maya: Heads-up — visitor dropping off an inflatable flamingo for the demo at 3:15. Where can we stash it before the room?
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in: Samir Patel arriving 3:15pm. Package for Maya delivered. Placing in secure locker L-14.
tess: If it fits, storage-A by the kitchen is best. Otherwise locker L-14 temporarily works.
maya: locker L-14 is fine. Thx :pray:
frontdesk-bot: Locker assigned L-14. Code:
```4829
Expires in 6 hours
```
oliver: Quick badge note — Samir has guest badge 'G-324'. Front desk will escort.
jamal: Do we need an air pump? inflatable things + tiny chairs = chaos 😅
maya: I’ve got a battery pump in my desk. @jamal I’ll bring it to front desk.
zoe: Poll: stream couch (lobby sofa) or high-top tables for demo setup? React with :couch: or :trophy: (high-top)
tess: :couch:
oliver: :trophy:
maya: tallying — looks like 2 high-top, 1 couch. leaning high-top.
frontdesk-bot: Package note: label reads "TINY FOAM FLAMINGO — DO NOT BEND". Placed in L-14 with Maya's name.
samir: thanks everyone! will be a quick drop and I'll be in-and-out.
maya: great, I'll meet Samir at lobby at 3:10. anyone want a flamingo selfie? :flamingo:
zoe: I do. also can someone plug the pump in? battery low.
maya: plugged in at front desk.
jamal: perfect. see you all in a bit.
frontdesk-bot: Thread closed when Samir checked in at 3:17pm (auto-note).
